description: POPLA's own record of how private parking appeals were decided, per operator, across its 2023, 2024 and 2025 annual reports. Give an operator for its three-year series and its change in percentage points; omit it for the all-operator totals and a ranking. These are decided appeals only — appeals an operator withdraws end in the driver's favour without a ruling and are counted separately.

limit.description: How many operators to return in the ranking when no operator is given. Default 20.

operator.description: Operator name, trading name or slug. Omit for the estate-wide summary and ranking.

order.description: Ranking order when no operator is given. Default best_for_driver.

name: popla_outcomes
title: UK parking appeals — POPLA outcomes by operator
